info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, Ypos, mapXPos, loopX, loopWidthglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDListon beginSprite  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 3  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  loopX = (gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.25) - Xpos  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.25endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    Xpos = Xpos + ((gXVel + gXOffset) * 0.25)    if Xpos > loopX then      Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth    end if    if Xpos < -loopX then      Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth    end if    this.locH = Xpos    this.locV = Ypos  end ifend
info.name: OilRig
